title: Menus and food
focus: Reading menus: 鸡 鸭 鱼 牛肉 猪肉 面 饭 汤 饺子 炒 烤 辣 甜 酸; 菜单 点菜 买单.
body:
# Menus and food

Chinese menus follow a pattern: **cooking method + main ingredient**, or **ingredient + dish type**. 炒饭 is stir-fried rice, 烤鸭 is roast duck, 牛肉面 is beef noodles. Read the dish name in pieces and you can order almost anything.

Radicals help a lot here. Fire 火 means a cooking method, 饣 means food, 鸟 means a bird, and 酉 (a wine jar) means something fermented.

| Group | Characters | Pinyin |
|---|---|---|
| Meat (肉 ròu) | 鸡 鸭 鱼 牛肉 猪肉 羊肉 | jī yā yú niúròu zhūròu yángròu |
| Staples | 饭 面 饺子 包子 豆腐 | fàn miàn jiǎozi bāozi dòufu |
| Cooking (火 fire) | 炒 烤 | chǎo kǎo (stir-fry, roast) |
| Tastes | 辣 甜 酸 咸 | là tián suān xián |
| Soup and drink | 汤 啤酒 | tāng píjiǔ |
| At the table | 菜单 点菜 买单 筷子 服务员 | càidān diǎncài mǎidān kuàizi fúwùyuán |

On a menu, 肉 alone usually means pork. Beef, chicken and lamb get named: 牛肉, 鸡肉, 羊肉.

## Examples

- 服务员,点菜! fúwùyuán, diǎncài: Excuse me, we're ready to order!
- 我看一下菜单。 wǒ kàn yíxià càidān: Let me look at the menu.
- 我要一个炒饭。 wǒ yào yí ge chǎofàn: I'll have a fried rice.
- 我想吃牛肉面。 wǒ xiǎng chī niúròumiàn: I feel like beef noodles.
- 这个辣不辣? zhège là bu là: Is this spicy?
- 我不吃辣的。 wǒ bù chī là de: I don't eat spicy food.
- 这个汤有点咸。 zhège tāng yǒudiǎn xián: This soup is a bit salty.
- 奶奶在包饺子。 nǎinai zài bāo jiǎozi: Grandma's making dumplings.
- 这个包子是猪肉的。 zhège bāozi shì zhūròu de: This bun has pork filling.
- 我来买单。 wǒ lái mǎidān: I'll get the bill.

## Common mistakes

- **汤 vs 场.** Same right side. 汤 (tāng, soup) has 氵 water; 场 (chǎng, field, venue) has 土 earth.
- **咸 vs 成.** 咸 (xián, salty) has a 口 inside; 成 (chéng) does not.
- **买单 vs 卖.** You 买单 (mǎidān), pay the bill. 卖 (mài, sell) has an extra 十 on top.

cards.Example: 这个鸡好吃。 zhège jī hǎochī: This chicken is good.
cards.Notes: 又 + 鸟 bird; the same 鸟 is in 鸭

cards.Example: 爸爸喜欢吃鱼。 bàba xǐhuan chī yú: Dad likes fish.
cards.Notes: A picture of a fish: head on top, tail at the bottom; the radical in 鲜 (xiān, fresh)

cards.Example: 我不吃牛肉。 wǒ bù chī niúròu: I don't eat beef.
cards.Notes: 牛 vs 午 (wǔ): in 牛 the middle stroke pokes through the top

cards.Example: 这是猪肉吗? zhè shì zhūròu ma: Is this pork?
cards.Notes: 猪 = 犭 animal + 者 zhě for the sound

cards.Example: 爷爷喜欢吃羊肉。 yéye xǐhuan chī yángròu: Grandpa likes lamb.
cards.Notes: 羊 has two horns on top; also inside 美 and 鲜

cards.Example: 我想吃牛肉面。 wǒ xiǎng chī niúròumiàn: I feel like beef noodles.
cards.Notes: 面 means both noodles and face (面子)

cards.Example: 我要一个炒饭。 wǒ yào yí ge chǎofàn: I'll have a fried rice.
cards.Notes: 炒 = 火 fire + 少 shǎo for the sound

cards.Example: 你喝汤吗? nǐ hē tāng ma: Do you want some soup?
cards.Notes: 氵 water; 汤 vs 场 (chǎng): same right side, 土 earth instead

cards.Example: 奶奶在包饺子。 nǎinai zài bāo jiǎozi: Grandma's making dumplings.
cards.Notes: 饺 = 饣 food + 交 jiāo for the sound

cards.Example: 今天晚上吃烤鸭。 jīntiān wǎnshang chī kǎoyā: We're having roast duck tonight.
cards.Notes: 烤 = 火 fire + 考 kǎo; 鸭 = 甲 jiǎ + 鸟 bird

cards.Example: 这个辣不辣? zhège là bu là: Is this spicy?
cards.Notes: 辛 (xīn, pungent) on the left, as in 辛苦

cards.Example: 我不喜欢甜的。 wǒ bù xǐhuan tián de: I don't like sweet things.
cards.Notes: 舌 tongue + 甘 gān (sweet): sweet on the tongue

cards.Example: 我要一个酸辣汤。 wǒ yào yí ge suānlàtāng: I'll have a hot and sour soup.
cards.Notes: 酉 (a wine jar) on the left: fermented things, as in 酒 and 醋 (cù, vinegar)

cards.Example: 这个菜不咸。 zhège cài bù xián: This dish isn't salty.
cards.Notes: 咸 vs 成 (chéng): 咸 has 口 inside

cards.Example: 我看一下菜单。 wǒ kàn yíxià càidān: Let me look at the menu.
cards.Notes: 单 means a list or bill; the same 单 as in 买单

cards.Example: 你们点菜了吗? nǐmen diǎncài le ma: Have you ordered?
cards.Notes: 点 has four fire dots 灬 at the bottom

cards.Example: 我来买单。 wǒ lái mǎidān: I'll get the bill.
cards.Notes: 买 (buy), not 卖 (mài, sell), which has 十 on top

cards.Example: 我早上吃一个鸡蛋。 wǒ zǎoshang chī yí ge jīdàn: I eat an egg in the morning.
cards.Notes: 蛋 has 虫 (creature) at the bottom

cards.Example: 这个包子是猪肉的。 zhège bāozi shì zhūròu de: This bun has pork filling.
cards.Notes: 包 = to wrap; the sound part of 饱 and 跑

cards.Example: 我喜欢吃豆腐。 wǒ xǐhuan chī dòufu: I like tofu.
cards.Notes: 腐 = 府 fǔ for the sound + 肉 meat underneath

cards.Example: 这个菜好吃! zhège cài hǎochī: This dish is delicious!
cards.Notes: 好 = 女 + 子; for drinks say 好喝

cards.Example: 这是你的筷子。 zhè shì nǐ de kuàizi: These are your chopsticks.
cards.Notes: 竹 bamboo on top + 快 kuài for the sound

cards.Example: 服务员来了。 fúwùyuán lái le: The waiter's coming.
cards.Notes: 员 = 口 over 贝: a member of staff

cards.Example: 爸爸喜欢喝啤酒。 bàba xǐhuan hē píjiǔ: Dad likes beer.
cards.Notes: 啤 = 口 + 卑 bēi; 酒 = 氵 liquid + 酉 jar

cards.Meaning: Excuse me, we're ready to order!
cards.Notes: 点 vs 店 (diàn, shop): 店 has a 广 roof
辣的 = spicy stuff: 的 turns the adjective into a thing

cards.Meaning: This soup is a bit salty.
cards.Notes: 有点 = a bit (usually a complaint)
包 vs 句 (jù, sentence): 包 has 巳 inside, 句 has 口
饣 on the left of 饺 tells you it's food before you read it
